title: Research Collaboration on Synthetic Transcription Factors
summary: This cluster consists of researchers and institutions involved in the study of synthetic transcription factors. Borah Madhushruti is the common author among the entities, indicating their collaboration on the topic. Arenz Christoph, Gu Shanna, Koffas Mattheos, Saied Essa M., and Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin are also authors of works related to Borah Madhushruti's research. Microb Cell Fact and BMC are also associated with Borah Madhushruti's work, suggesting their involvement in the research. 3'-phosphoadenosine 5'-phosphosulfate is a chemical mentioned in one of Borah Madhushruti's works.
